proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, about half of Ibn Turka's 46 known works (22 published) remain in manuscript, including most lettrist works and the Munsha'at-i Turka (some 50 letters); Akhlati's own writings are mostly inaccessible; the published Tamhid is the most-studied work.

mediation.note: MK's own account of the state of the record, which also frames the limits of his argument.
